title: Global Markets Brief — 27 Nov 2026
intro: Global markets present a mixed picture during the Asian session as equities diverge and commodities rally strongly. Risk sentiment remains underpinned by solid Asian equity performance alongside surging precious and industrial metals.

sections.heading: Today's calendar (CET)
sections.content: - 🟠 00:30 · JPY Tokyo Core CPI y/y · (f 3.0% · p 2.6%)

sections.heading: 🌍 Macro tone
sections.content: The macro environment reflects localized risk appetite driven by strong industrial data in China and broad commodity gains, offset by minor pullbacks in US technology indices. Sovereign wealth fund behavior and geopolitical tensions continue to shape cross-asset positioning.

sections.heading: 🛢 Oil desk
sections.content: WTI trades at 86.40, up 3.25% on the day, while Brent sits at 92.79, down 1.92% with the spread narrowing to 6.39. Crude markets are reacting to evolving geopolitical headlines and shifting supply dynamics across key producing regions.

sections.heading: Cross-asset read
sections.content: US Treasury yields retreated, with the 10Y down 5.6bp to 4.848% and the 30Y dropping 5.7bp to 5.235%, while the DXY held flat at 103.67. Meanwhile, commodities experienced explosive upside with Silver surging 11.46% and Gold up 4.41%, contrasted with mild weakness in US index futures.
